result.title: A Recipe for Physical Action Model Training
result.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables; ancillary code and numerical results included
result.summary: Choosing robot model capacity and demonstration budgets also requires decisions about data composition, representation, optimization, and deployment. We connect these decisions through a common conditional-distribution target. Nested learning oracles give exact risk accounting; local information geometry, conditional mutual information, and empirical convergence provide conditional training prescriptions. Known-target numerical checks expose capacity-data coupling, representation-induced mixture mismatch, and an example where deployment KL increases while negative log-likelihood decreases. An analysis of 206 public PushT trajectories evaluates fixed-feature information-design criteria without fitting a policy. Under asymmetric evaluation targets, the selected allocations reduce this criterion by 4.5-6.2% relative to target matching; balanced targets show no benefit. These results clarify which quantities can support training recommendations and when an apparently favorable predictive metric has a different interpretation.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文以条件分布为统一目标，分析机器人动作模型的容量、演示数据预算、数据组成与表示选择，用嵌套学习 oracle 做风险核算，并在 PushT 轨迹上检验信息设计准则。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「容量—数据耦合」「表示导致的混合失配」以及 NLL 下降而部署 KL 上升的例子，可能为 LVR 训练监督与评价指标选择（预测指标是否反映真实使用）提供核查线索，但领域相距较远。
